job_post_detail.title: Visual Designer-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
1、Use AIGC tools to support the creation of campaign visuals, product scenes, lifestyle images, and social content.
2、Assist the creative team in developing visual concepts, moodboards, references, and design directions.
3、Create AI-generated images based on product briefs, brand direction, and campaign needs.
4、Help refine prompts, test different visual styles, and improve image quality through iteration.
5、Work with designers, 3D artists, video editors, and retouchers to complete final creative assets.
6、Support daily design tasks for social media, e-commerce, product launch, and marketing campaigns.
7、Learn and apply Antigravity’s brand style, product details, and visual standards.
8、Explore new AI tools and creative workflows to improve team efficiency and output quality.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Fresh graduate or junior designer from Visual Communication, Graphic Design, Digital Media, Advertising, Animation, Photography, Film, or related majors.
2、Strong visual sense, good taste, and interest in technology, drones, lifestyle, gaming, or consumer electronics.
3、Basic design skills in layout, composition, color, typography, and image editing.
4、Experience or strong interest in AIGC tools such as Midjourney, ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, Nano Banana, Kling, Runway, or similar tools.
5、Basic knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or other design tools.
6、Able to learn fast, take feedback, and improve work through multiple iterations.
7、Open-minded, proactive, detail-oriented, and willing to explore new creative methods.
8、Portfolio required, including design work, AI visual experiments, photography, 3D, illustration, or personal creative projects.
